compositionRules.navigation: The 52 px activity rail exclusively owns global destinations, Settings and Account on desktop. The 224 px second sidebar owns context selection, local sections, filters, and settings categories. Resource lists, tables, and viewers belong entirely in the right work pane, including task lists and changed files. Omit generic cross-destination links and repeated horizontal or return navigation. On compact panes, open the current sidebar as a drawer with one global-navigation fallback.
compositionRules.location: The location bar names the current resource; the contextual sidebar owns local sections.
compositionRules.context: Task scope lives in a compact status bar. Additional source and execution details open on request in an accessible inspector dialog at every width.
compositionRules.density: Desktop navigation rows are 34 px; touch rows are at least 44 px.
compositionRules.actions: Reserve strong emphasis for the next decision. Keep secondary actions quiet.
compositionRules.identity: Name resources in the location bar and sections in the contextual sidebar. Do not repeat them as page headings or add descriptive boilerplate.
compositionRules.files: Repository folder browsing and source viewing stay entirely in the right work pane. Start with a full-width directory table: Name, Last commit, Updated, Size. Open folders to drill in; use breadcrumbs and the enclosing-folder action to return. Keep repository selection and Files/Issues/Pull requests in the contextual sidebar.
compositionRules.workbenches: Resource lists, tables, conversations, code review, file browsers, deployment history and log consoles fill the right work pane without outer gutters or inset cards. Keep toolbars fixed and scroll data independently. A changed-file table sits above the selected diff within the work pane; the contextual sidebar only switches task sections.
compositionRules.logs: Give logs the full work area. Show release once, scope in filters, and aligned timestamp, service, level and message columns.
compositionRules.chat: Conversations and the docked composer fill the content pane. Keep prose readable within a full-width transcript. Name task status once in the location bar, checks beside changed files, and scope in the status bar.
compositionRules.tasks: New tasks use a full-height task editor beneath the location and suggestion toolbars. Keep scope in the status bar; omit welcome headings, generic descriptions and invented revision metadata.
compositionRules.resources: Application overview and computer lists fill the work area. Use aligned resource rows, thin separators and expandable detail instead of inset cards. Show platform or scope once in the appropriate column or toolbar.
compositionRules.settings: Use full-width property rows with labels and controls aligned in columns. Keep save state and Save/Discard actions in a fixed footer. Keep variable values masked and show variable names inside a disclosure.
compositionRules.repository: Show repository linkage and its direct navigation action in application settings. Repository selection and Files/Issues/Pull requests belong in the repository sidebar; do not repeat those destinations as application tabs or related navigation groups.
compositionRules.repositoryWork: Issues and pull requests fill their pane with a fixed search/filter toolbar and aligned list rows. Titles appear once in expandable summaries; keep meaningful criteria, checks, file diffs and agent actions inside detail. No inset cards or generic descriptions.
compositionRules.overlays: Use one dialog title and omit repeated introductions. Dialogs have 16 px insets and fixed action footers; menus have 8 px insets and 34 px desktop / 44 px touch rows. Pickers use group labels rather than repeated titles. Anchor and clamp popovers to the work area. Only one picker opens at a time; arrows/Home/End navigate, Tab exits, Escape dismisses the top layer and restores focus. Keep source, permission scope, deployment impact and recovery explicit.
compositionRules.continuity: Use a shared 16 px desktop / 12 px phone content inset. Fit the preview workspace to the available viewport and show the simulation caption once. Carry the active task name through conversation, code review and release. Use the contextual sidebar for section changes and return navigation; avoid repeated back buttons and workflow strips. Analytics uses a flat two-column desktop grid and one column on compact panes.
compositionRules.rightPanes: Every right work pane fills the remaining width and height with no outer card or content gutter. Use one compact toolbar for related context and controls; repository branch and path share a row, and inspector release and scope share a row. Keep data padding at the shared 16 px desktop / 12 px compact inset, preserve readable document text, pin controls and status bars, and scroll content locally. Resource rows activate across their full width, support keyboard traversal, and preserve each file’s reading position. Compact code review uses one native file picker rather than a clipped file table.
compositionRules.keyboard: F6 and Shift+F6 move between the activity rail, context navigation, and the work pane, returning to the last focused resource. Up/Down/Home/End traverse navigation and resource lists; Enter/Space activate controls. Right/Left open and close disclosures; Right opens a selected folder and Alt+Up returns to its parent. In source viewers and consoles, unmodified arrows and Page Up/Down scroll content. Tab follows native control order. Compact navigation behaves as a modal drawer; Escape closes the top overlay and restores its trigger. Focus has a visible inset outline distinct from selection.
compositionRules.resourceState: Keep drafts, caret selections, selected files, project searches, repository sorting, open disclosures, and horizontal/vertical reading positions when switching resources during the session. Key state by resource and scope, never by DOM position. Preserve focus on initiating navigation and form controls after rerenders; restore the last work control when reentering a pane. Preference actions focus the active category, and restored reading positions never move the whole page.
compositionRules.feedback: Use one compact inline feedback row in the affected right pane: a 16 px icon, one short title, optional cause or preserved-work detail, and a specific recovery action. Use the shared 16 px desktop / 12 px compact inset and 32 px desktop / 44 px touch controls. Loading keeps navigation and drafts available, marks the pane busy, and offers Cancel for a long request. Empty search results clear filters; first-use states point to existing creation controls without duplicating toolbar actions. Errors use danger plus text and Retry or a concrete fix; pending decisions use warning. Preserve drafts, form values, selections, review state, and reading positions through recovery. Never convert missing telemetry to zero or healthy. Inline field errors stay attached to their input. Demo states live in the review bar, outside product navigation.
compositionRules.inputs: Use TextField from @/components/ui with the default bordered appearance for configuration and standalone forms. Use appearance="plain" inside an existing toolbar or row. Legacy inputs, textareas and input shells use data-appearance="plain". Plain entry is transparent, has zero enclosing border, radius, shadow, and inline padding, including hover. Focus uses the shared form.focusWidth underline in accent; invalid entry uses danger plus associated error text. Preserve labels, native editing, read-only selection, disabled semantics, and 44 px touch targets. Forced colors use a system-color bottom rule. Apply the shared appearance to task, computer, issue, pull request, log, and command searches; never replace them with per-view unboxed styles.
compositionRules.content: Every product label must name a modeled resource, state, scope, or working action. Omit invented networks, environments, backup policies, isolation/traffic guarantees, quotas, provider catalogs, capability claims, and success messages for operations that do not execute. Unknown values stay unavailable, never fabricated. Illustrative data belongs to the named design-system specimens, with one simulation caption; decorative context and toast-only product actions are omitted. Keep reference/history examples visibly separate from current behavior.
compositionRules.brand: Landing, documentation, authentication and workspace share the same lavender action, plum neutrals, typography and focus tokens. Metric and status colors retain their semantic roles. The landing page uses a floating dashboard launcher; dashboard routes use only the activity rail and contextual navigation.
